dedupe_keys.name: opencontour cloud mine planning scheduling and heap leach stacking

description: Opencontour is a cloud-based mine planning tool with modules for open pit mine design, mid and long-range open pit scheduling and heap leach stacking. Engineers import base surface contours and block models to generate pit designs and review mid-bench contours, geotechnical inter-ramp angles and ramp and cut requirements, build schedules with pre-populated reports or data entered through scripts and editable charts, and plan stacking by month, quarter, year or a user-defined period, comparing the costs and benefits of alternative designs. It is produced by Opencontour, with the site in English and Spanish. Coverage is global and generic. A free Mine Design module is available after signing up, while the Pro version and other modules are paid subscriptions, and training and consulting are quoted per project; the tool runs in the cloud while files stay on the user's own drive. Caveats: the page is marketing material, no technical documentation or prices were read, and it serves planning, not hazard analysis. For simulation it gives accessible pit design and scheduling models for testing how changes in slope limits or production plans affect mine output, a step in resilience and capacity studies of mineral supply. It is related to the K-MINE record in this catalogue, a full desktop suite.
